A '''Sith Lord''' served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and taught the [[Beast-Lord]] [[Brutann]]. [[Darth Savik]] recalled in [[3627 BBY]] that this Sith Lord had served [[Darth Jadus]] in some unspecified manner before the latter disappeared from galactic prominence.<ref name="Onslaught" />

The Sith worked under Darth Jadus and as such served the Sith Lord as one of his superior's intermediaries in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] network.<ref name="Holonet" />
